name: modcrafting-workbuddy
description: Develop and deterministically validate Fabric 1.21.4 mods inside WorkBuddy.

displayDescription.en: Build Fabric 1.21.4 content, textures and recipes locally, then run deterministic in-game tests and report reproducible evidence inside WorkBuddy.
displayDescription.zh: 在本地制作 Fabric 1.21.4 模组的内容、贴图、配方与界面，构建后自动进入游戏跑确定性玩法测试，并输出可复查的验收报告。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Inspect this project, tell me whether it can build, and open the workbench.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 检查当前工程能不能开始开发，并打开工作台。

quickPrompts.en: Inspect this project, tell me whether it can build, and open the workbench.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查当前工程能不能开始开发，并打开工作台。

quickPrompts.en: Add an edible blueberry with a texture and a recipe.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个能吃的蓝莓，包含贴图和配方。

quickPrompts.en: Run a deterministic gameplay test and summarize the verdict and evidence.
quickPrompts.zh: 跑一次确定性玩法测试，并把结论和证据整理给我。
